civilopediaText.text: Emperor Sheev Palpatine, in reality the powerful Sith Lord Darth Sidious, ruled the entire Galaxy for 23 years at the head of the Empire he proclaimed following the Galactic Republic at the end of the Clone Wars.
The Predator Skal'nas is a military leader renowned even among the Rakatas for his cruelty and tendency towards betrayal.

Belonging to a mysterious species, Yoda, Grand Master of the Jedi Order, is one of the most respected members of his Order, often considered the embodiment of the ideal Jedi due to his respect for all forms of life and his desire to preserve peace and good throughout the Galaxy.

Jabba Desilijic Tiure, nicknamed Jabba the Hutt, is one of the most powerful gangsters in the Outer Rim, dominating the criminal underworld of the planet Tatooine as one of the most important leaders of the Hutt Cartel.
Xim, son of Xer, was the tyrannical ruler of his own empire built through his conquests in the Tion Cluster decades before the rise of the Galactic Republic.

One of the last Taung to claim the title of Mandalore, Mandalore the Ultimate is the founder of the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders who sought to end the decadence of Mandalorian military traditions and reunify the Mandalorian clans to lead them against the Galactic Republic in the Mandalorian Wars.

Revan, known as the Revanchist, honored as Revan, reviled as Revan the Butcher, feared as the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Revan, and praised as the Prodigal Knight, is a complex character, both protector and destroyer of the Galactic Republic, the greatest of the Jedi and the greatest of the Sith.

Count Dooku of Serenno was once a Jedi Knight and a loyal servant of the Galactic Republic, but, disillusioned by the corruption of the Galactic Senate and the conservatism and arrogance of the Jedi Order, he turned to the dark side, becoming the Sith Lord Darth Tyrannus, and became the leader of the Separatist Alliance that seeks to replace the Republic.

A former Senator from the planet Chandrila, Mon Mothma has always been a fierce opponent of the authoritarianism of the Galactic Empire and a supporter of democracy, which is why she joined forces with other republican politicians to form the Alliance for the Restoration of the Republic, which she leads.

Supreme Overlord of the Yuuzhan Vong, Shimrra Jamaane is a warlord feared by all and convinced that his species must invade the galaxy and reorganize it in his image by eradicating the Jedi and technology. Confident in his power, he did not hesitate to challenge the Yun'o, the Yuuzhan Vong gods, and dreams of taking their place.
One of the most powerful Force users to have ever existed, Valkorion, known as the Immortal Emperor, has been the ruler of the planet Zakel and its Eternal Empire for centuries.

A great lover of art, Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo, better known as Thrawn, is one of the few Imperial officers who is not a human but a Chiss from the Chiss Ascendancy to whom his true loyalty lies and whom he served effectively in various conflicts in the Unknown Regions before joining the Galactic Empire's Navy.

Tenel Ka Djo, whose full name is Tenel Ka Chume Ta' Djo, is an heiress of the Royal House of Hapes who long preferred to follow the path of the witches of Dathomir and then the Jedi Knights before being forced to become the Queen Mother and leader of the Hapes Consortium.
The ExO is the leader elected by the Directors of the Corporate Sector Authority to chair their meetings and present corporate policies to the public.
Deceitful and cowardly, Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray is a ruthless and greedy businessman willing to do anything to ensure the wealth of his company.
